title: Space page lifecycle refuses incompatible native node storage before legacy downgrade can erase authored work

source.ref: task10/11 bounded Space writer compatibility child after LIVE-871

detail:
Owner-authorized E0 decomposition after LIVE-871. Scope is Space page autosave/publish/discard only: reject incompatible incoming inline nodes or stored bench, and stale legacy mutations over native published/draft storage before sanitization or any database write. Preserve parsed legacy nodes projection compatibility, ordinary legacy saves and authorization ordering. Behavioral plain-Node probe runs shipped actions with auth/database boundaries stubbed against pinned historical storage-shape fixtures with synthetic authored values and an adversarial full document. Does not close task10, task11 or PROG-E0: all legacy type dedupe, stored-bench mutation, inline renderer and other writer conversion remain open; no native persistence, backfill, migration or Yjs work.

Space autosave/publish/discard now refuse incompatible incoming inline node cells/stored bench and stale legacy writes over native published or draft documents before sanitizing or touching preferences. Authorization refusal remains first; legacy parsed nodes projections and ordinary saves/publish/discard remain compatible. Behavioral plain-Node probe executes shipped actions and proves 345 no-write, exact authored-byte preservation cases over the SHA-pinned 37-document historical-shape reconstruction with synthetic authored values plus adversarial nested authored fixture, including unknown types, duplicate placements, stored bench and hidden content. Targeted tests and lint pass. Bounded Space lifecycle guard only; all six legacy dedupe sites, inline renderer, other writers, native persistence/backfill and deferred Yjs remain open under E0. Shared client autosave now retains a refused/thrown full draft snapshot and dirty navigation warning, keeps newer per-field edits rather than replacing them with an older failed attempt, serializes a subject generation, and prevents outgoing Space failures from requeueing into another Space. Only newer edits schedule another attempt; a persistent refusal does not spin an automatic retry loop. Actual client tests cover returned error, thrown transport error, in-flight newer edits, success and subject handoff. This is in-memory recovery while mounted, not new browser localStorage durability.

verify.note: Actual Space lifecycle actions, framework/auth/data boundaries stubbed; pinned authored corpus, no nested test runner.
